accepted.sentence: Before departure, crew inspect hatches, valves, and seals, then test emergency systems to confirm the pressure boundary is secure.
Fresh water is produced from seawater by distillation or reverse osmosis, supplying drinking and cooking needs during extended patrols.
Crew members stand rotating watches, monitoring navigation, machinery, communications, and cabin conditions continuously.
To deploy divers, a lockout chamber is flooded and equalized with outside pressure before its outer hatch opens.
When operating near the seabed, careful speed and depth adjustments help avoid stirring sediment that could impair visibility or sensor readings.
A tow cable can stream a hydrophone array behind the vessel, placing its sensors farther from machinery noise.
A communication buoy may rise to the surface and relay messages through an antenna while the vessel remains submerged.
If smoke appears, personnel isolate the affected compartment, close ventilation ducts, and use extinguishers suited to the fire.
